pantry_item_quantity_check.name: pantry_item_quantity_check
pantry_item_quantity_check.value: ("pantry_item"."quantity" IS NULL AND "pantry_item"."quantity_unit" IS NULL) OR ("pantry_item"."quantity" > 0 AND "pantry_item"."quantity_unit" IS NOT NULL)

shopping_list_closed_at_check.name: shopping_list_closed_at_check
shopping_list_closed_at_check.value: ("shopping_list"."status" = 'active' AND "shopping_list"."closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("shopping_list"."status" = 'archived' AND "shopping_list"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
